quantitative_conclusions: J300-J200 best: AbsRel mean -0.00062190 but two seeds worsen and one improves; CI crosses zero. F1 +0.01614688 CI [0.01104505,0.02204513], two seeds improve and one loses 0.00013994. Other four metric CIs cross zero. The full group supersedes the provisional two-seed mean depth regression, without establishing a depth scaling benefit.

J300-L300 best: AbsRel +0.00216113 and RMSE +0.00435269 worsen in all three seeds, but their scene CIs cross zero. F1 +0.02814143 CI [0.02158807,0.03520682], paired seed changes [+0.01693886,-0.01277306,+0.08025848]. This supersedes the provisional two-seed F1 interval crossing zero; the large third-seed contribution and opposite second-seed direction remain important. The other four CIs cross zero, including boundary-band error.

J300-R300 best: mean AbsRel -0.00343280 in all seeds but CI crosses zero; F1 +0.01151461 and band AbsRel -0.00702261 improve in all three seeds with CIs excluding zero. Other three CIs cross zero. The F1 interval now excludes zero, unlike the two-seed provisional result.

J300-B0 best: all five metrics improve in all seeds and all five scene CIs exclude zero. F1 +0.01075917 CI [0.00236121,0.01939365] now excludes zero after adding the third seed. At final, four depth/band metrics still improve with CIs excluding zero, while F1 -0.00026508 has CI crossing zero and seed signs -/+/+.

J400-J300 best: all seeds improve AbsRel (-0.00328805), RMSE (-0.01083661), delta1 (+0.00202387), and band AbsRel (-0.00205729). AbsRel, RMSE and band CIs exclude zero; delta1 crosses zero. F1 -0.00692673 CI [-0.01176415,-0.00263456], with seed signs +/-/-. More data improves depth values here but does not uniformly improve boundaries.

J400-J300 final: all five group mean metrics worsen with scene CIs excluding zero, strongly driven by the previously documented J400 seed320114 late instability. For AbsRel, RMSE, delta1 and band, the first two seeds improve while the third worsens; F1 signs are +/-/-. Preserve the known failure rather than implying uniform data-count harm. This supersedes the provisional two-seed final RMSE gain.

J300-J200 final: only F1 (+0.00973204) has a CI excluding zero, but seed signs -/+/-; other four cross zero. J300-L300 final: only F1 (+0.07487107) excludes zero, seed signs +/-/+ and much of the gain reflects L300 seed320114 edge deterioration. Other four cross zero. J300-R300 final: only band AbsRel (-0.00761183) has a nonzero CI; other four cross zero.

J300 final-best: AbsRel +0.00189109 and RMSE +0.00332578 worsen in all seeds but CIs cross zero. Delta1 -0.00954938 worsens in all seeds with a negative CI. F1 -0.01102425 has negative CI [-0.01579720,-0.00706152] but seed113 slightly improves. Band AbsRel -0.00059973 has a CI crossing zero and seed signs +/+/-; no uniform endpoint regression across all metrics.

Scene intervals use 2000 paired scene-cluster resamples, seed320119, after averaging matched training seeds per image. They are conditional on these three training seeds; sample SD is reported separately, with no multiple-comparison correction. No test data were accessed and no configuration was changed.
training_review: Seed114 best and significant-improvement anchor are step400, stop1400 by ten stale validations; final AbsRel is 0.99197% above best. Final alone being within1% does not satisfy the terminal500-step condition; stable is NULL for all three J300 seeds.

Seed114 validation quickly improves then oscillates around0.094-0.096 while train loss falls to0.03829. This is a plateau with modest post-best degradation, without the explosive divergence observed in J400 seed114. The configured late_loss_down_val_up indicator is false for this run; do not replace it with a claimed positive flag.

Seed114 reaches the sustained0.10 target starting step100 and confirmed at300; no sustained0.09 target. Across J300, mean best step1100, stop1966.67; stable0/3. The other0.10 confirmation steps are700 and300.

Seed114 has1400 attempts,1399 successful updates,11200 exposures,37.3333 effective epochs. One AMP skip at290, before best, with no later skip or recorded failure/restart. This does not establish a cause for the later edge changes.

qualitative_cases_seed320114.nyuv2_0005: Best and final improve board/wall metric depth relative to B0, with final AbsRel0.0679->0.0638. The main tabletop/chair outline remains broadly present; small matched segments are reduced and F1 falls0.370->0.325. The large board perimeter remains missed despite its better interior depth.
qualitative_cases_seed320114.nyuv2_0598: Both endpoints have worse depth error than B0; final increases error on the floor/sofa/table support, AbsRel0.0578->0.0641. The table right boundary visibly changes from cyan to mostly red, and predicted edges1325->909; F1 drops0.524->0.411. Table legs and far-sofa boundaries remain largely missed.
qualitative_cases_seed320114.nyuv2_1440: Both endpoints have greater foreground chair/counter depth error than B0. Final AbsRel0.1059->0.1141 and F1 0.546->0.494; more yellow unmatched thin vertical structures appear inside the foreground chair even though the total edge count increases3720->4029. More predicted edges do not guarantee better localization.
qualitative_cases_seed320114.nyuv2_0226: Both endpoints substantially reduce the broad wall/person depth error of B0, and final improves AbsRel0.2367->0.2269. Main person/column/sofa contours remain visible, but thinner branch/furniture fragments lose matching, with F1 0.500->0.473. This demonstrates opposing depth-value and boundary changes.
qualitative_cases_seed320114.nyuv2_0246: Both endpoints are worse than B0 in depth values, with final broad wall/ceiling/foreground errors increasing0.1461->0.1656. Foreground silhouette is largely retained, F1 only modestly falls0.517->0.508; false ceiling discontinuity and missed narrow central shelf structure persist.
qualitative_cases_seed320114.nyuv2_0080: Best recovers several matched shelf verticals and improves both AbsRel and F1 over B0. Final removes almost all these matched verticals: F1 0.598->0.100, predicted edges784->54, and AbsRel0.0935->0.1112. The raw outputs are finite positive nonconstant; this is endpoint boundary degradation rather than missing predictions.

interpretation: At300 images J improves depth versus B0 and has a three-seed mean boundary advantage over standalone R/L, but L retains lower mean AbsRel in every matched seed. Boundary gains vary substantially by seed and can disappear after continued training. J400 best improves depth further but its documented unstable final seed must remain visible. No uniform winner is established before completing the planned counts and staged route.
